action.prompt: A UI or copy file was saved. Check its user-facing text against .kiro/steering/tone.md and neutrality.md. Flag: judgemental words (soared, plunged, skyrocketed, finally fell), exclamation marks, puns or horror clichés, and red/green or arrow styling that implies a number going up or down is good or bad. Report file and line for each hit, or say it is clean. Do not edit. Also flag: the retired tagline "Your past self returns with the receipts."; "rose-tinted"; any sentence that names the classroom time capsule as what Revenant resurrects, revives or brings back (the time capsule may appear as an example); old ritual names used as step names ("Recall first", "Reveal", "Snapshot", "Rest", "Return"); and accusing testimony words ("cross-examine", "caught", "wrong", "you misremembered").
